requirements.statement: Adjusted Product Code Data Segment (No. 157) added; data elements 76, 77, 81, 84, 85, 87, 106, and 107 updated with references to data segment 157.
requirements.constraint_text: These elements now reference Adjusted Product Code Data Segment (157)

requirements.statement: Data Section No. 3 of a Financial Transaction Request contains none, one, or more of the following data segments: Fleet (101), Product Code (102), EBT (103), Purchase Card (104), Variable Information (111), per the Data Section No. 3 table.
requirements.constraint_text: Data Section No. 3 may include segments 101, 102, 103, 104, and/or 111 as applicable

requirements.statement: Fleet Data Segment (101) is sent only on transactions requiring fleet data.
Segments 101â€“145 in Financial Transaction Request occupy Field Nos. 4â€“9 with specified maximum lengths (101:308, 102:381, 103:3334, 104:86, 111:999, 123:186, 135:110, 143:399, 145:999).
requirements.constraint_text: Adhere to stated max lengths in fields 4â€“9

requirements.statement: EMV Financial Transaction Request Data Section No. 3 contains one or more of: Fleet (101), Product Code (102), Purchase Card (104), Variable Information (111), EMV Request (130).
requirements.constraint_text: At least one of these segments included

requirements.statement: Segment 101 (Fleet Data Segment) is sent only on transactions requiring fleet data.
Segment Type field 3 of Data Segment 132 has fixed value 132.
Field 1 Segment Type in Segment 100 has fixed value 100.
Segment Length includes the Segment Type's length and Field Separators.
requirements.constraint_text: Segment Length value must include Segment Type length and Field Separators

requirements.statement: The Fleet Data Segment (Data Segment No. 101) is included in all fleet card transaction requests.
requirements.constraint_text: Fleet Data Segment (101) must be included in the request

requirements.statement: Merchants should not send the Fleet Data Segment (101) and the Enhanced Fleet Data Segment (145) together in the same message.
requirements.constraint_text: Enhanced Fleet Data Segment (145) must not also be present (and vice versa)

requirements.statement: The Fleet Data Segment has a maximum length of 61 characters, alphanumeric (0-9, a-z, A-Z).
All fields in the Fleet Data Segment are separated by Field Separators; when a field is not populated, the Field Separator must still be sent.
requirements.constraint_text: Field Separator must still be transmitted in its position

requirements.statement: Segment Type field in the Fleet Data Segment has fixed value 101.
Segment Length field identifies the data segment's length, including the Segment Type field's length and Field Separators.
requirements.constraint_text: Segment Length value must include Segment Type length and Field Separators

requirements.statement: The Fleet Data Segment originates at the device and can appear in any of the fields in Data Section No. 3.
requirements.constraint_text: Source = Device; placement = any field of Data Section No. 3

requirements.statement: Fleet Tag 1â€“5 fields are sent only in the Auth Completion (0220) message, and only when Host Prompts are supported.
requirements.constraint_text: Fleet Tag 1â€“5 may be sent (Tag=3 bytes fixed, Data up to 31 bytes)

requirements.statement: Each Fleet Tag consists of a 3-byte fixed-length Tag code followed by up to 31 bytes of Data.
requirements.constraint_text: Tag = 3 bytes fixed length; Data = up to 31 bytes

requirements.statement: The 3-byte Fleet Tag code must be one of: DLS (Driver License State/Province Abbrev, an3), DLN (Driver License name, an22), PON (Work Order/P.O. Number, an31), INV (Invoice Number, an31), TRP (Trip Number, an15), UNT (Unit Number, an31).
requirements.constraint_text: Tag code âˆˆ {DLS, DLN, PON, INV, TRP, UNT}

requirements.statement: A Field Separator always follows Segment Type and Segment Length. A Field Separator follows Product Amount when Product Amount is the very last element in the segment. When a field is not populated, still send the Field Separator.
requirements.constraint_text: Field Separator delimiter rules as stated

requirements.statement: Segment Length should be '4' for EBT with eWIC data transactions.
Segment Type is a fixed value of 103 for the EBT Data Segment.
Segment Type field is fixed value 104 for the Purchase Card Data Segment.
For Totals Data Segment, Segment Type (Field 1) has fixed value 105.
Segment Type in Loyalty Card Data Segment is fixed value 108.
Segment Type (field 1) has fixed value 109 for the Electronic Mail Data Segment.
Segment Type for Data Segment No. 111 has fixed value 111.
Segment Type in segment 112 must be the fixed value 112.
Segment Type (field 1) is fixed value 113 for the ECA/TeleCheck Data Segment.
Segment Type field is a fixed value of 115 for the Print Data Segment.
Segment Type field for Proprietary Data Load Segment has a fixed value of 118.
When Prompt Code = 902 (Dynamic Card Table Data), Field 14 contains Card Table Data (max 3,600 bytes, Required); its length is determined by the segment length in field 2.
requirements.constraint_text: Field 14 = Card Table Data, Required, max length 3,600, length determined by segment length in Field 2

requirements.statement: In segment 119, Segment Type has fixed value 119.
Segment Type field contains fixed value '120' for the Print Data 2 Segment.
Segment Type (Field 1) must be the fixed value 123.
Segment Type field for CA Public Key File Data Segment has fixed value 132.
Field Nos 1 and 2, and 2 and 3, are separated by Field Separators. The segment should end with a field separator. Data fields contained within field 3 are not separated by Field Separators.
requirements.constraint_text: Fields 1/2 and 2/3 separated by Field Separators; segment ends with a field separator; internal fields inside field 3 (Moneris Data) are not separated

requirements.statement: Segment Type for Data Segment 135 has a fixed value of 135.
Segment Type for Moneris Data (Response) Segment must have the fixed value 136.
Segment Type must be the fixed value 139 for the Moneris Day End Batch Balance Request Segment.
Segment Length includes Segment Type's length and Field Separators.
Segment Type field 1 has fixed value 141.
Segment Type field in Segment 142 has a fixed value of 142.
Merchants must not send Fleet segment (Data Segment No. 101) and Enhanced Fleet segment (Data Segment No. 145) together.
requirements.constraint_text: Fleet Segment (101) must not also be present (and vice versa)

requirements.statement: Segment Type field of Data Segment 146 must be fixed value '146'.

Example prompt string '004029|DRID:V1100|ODRD:N;TS;M1;X25|UNIT:O;PUN####|' shows Driver ID must equal 1100, Odometer must be a numeric string of length 1-25, and Unit is optional but must match pattern 'UN' + 4 digits.
requirements.constraint_text: DRID=1100; ODRD length 1-25 numeric; UNIT optional matching PUN####

requirements.statement: Within Segment 148, Segment Type (field 1) has fixed value 148.
Segment Type field must be fixed value 151 for the Request InComm OTC Market Basket Data Segment.
Segment Type for Data Segment 152 has a fixed value of 152.
Segment Type for Network Token Data Request Segment is fixed at value 153.
Segment Type in segment 155 is a fixed value of 155, length 3, required.

In Segment 157, a Field Separator always follows Segment Type and Segment Length; a Field Separator follows Adjusted Product Amount only when it is the very last element; when a field is not populated, still send the Field Separator.
Segment Type for the Adjusted Product Code Data Segment has fixed value 157.
Segment Length Indicator indicates the data segment's length exclusive of the Data Type Indicator.
requirements.constraint_text: Length value excludes the Data Type Indicator byte

requirements.statement: If required by the issuer, the Driver/Identification Number must be an unencrypted value and is found in the Fleet Data Segment (Segment No. 101).
requirements.constraint_text: Must be unencrypted and carried in Fleet Data Segment 101

requirements.statement: If required by the issuer, Fleet Employee Number is found in the Fleet Data Segment (Segment No. 101).
requirements.constraint_text: Element must appear in Fleet Data Segment (101)

requirements.statement: If required by the issuer, the Job Number element is found in the Fleet Data Segment (Segment No. 101).
requirements.constraint_text: Job Number appears in Fleet Data Segment (101)

requirements.statement: For Financial Transaction Requests, zero, one, or more of Data Segments 101 (Fleet), 102 (Product Code), 103 (EBT), 104 (Purchase Card), and 111 (Variable Information) may also follow.
requirements.constraint_text: Segments 101, 102, 103, 104, 111 are optional (none, one, or more)

requirements.statement: If required by the issuer, the Odometer element is found in the Fleet Data Segment (Segment No. 101).
requirements.constraint_text: Odometer placed in Fleet Data Segment (101)

requirements.statement: Odometer valid values range from 1 to 99999999.

Segment Length has a length of four digits only when transmitting EBT Data Segment (103), SKU Data Segment (114), Print Data Segment (115), Proprietary Data Load Segment (118), Print Data 2 Segment (120), EMV Request Data Segment (130), or EMV Response Data Segment (131). It cannot be 4 digits for any other segment.
requirements.constraint_text: Segment Length field is 4 digits; otherwise 3 digits

requirements.statement: Segment Length is calculated using the lengths of all data elements in the segment plus all Field Separators/Product Data Field Delimiters related to those elements.
requirements.constraint_text: Sum of element lengths plus separators/delimiters

requirements.statement: Value 28 indicates 'Unattended off premise customer-operated internet (nonsecure)' - a non-secure transaction in which the cardholder's payment card data was transmitted with no security method.
flags: Field context (likely POS Entry Mode or similar) not clearly identified on this page
requirements.constraint_text: Denotes unattended off-premise customer-operated nonsecure internet transaction

requirements.statement: A prior value (context continuation) indicates a transaction protected with a form of internet security such as SSL, but where authentication was not performed.
flags: Continuation from previous page; value code not shown
requirements.constraint_text: Indicates SSL-protected but non-authenticated internet transaction
